name: BiliReveal - 哔哩哔哩网页版显示 IP 属地 (Lite)
author: MaxChang3
description: 我不喜欢 IP 属地，但是你手机都显示了，为什么电脑不显示呢？在哔哩哔哩网页版大部分场景中显示 IP 属地。

checks.title: Single script parses as native JavaScript
Installable metadata and Bilibili-only scope
No external dependencies or unfinished code
checks.detail: AST imports/require, remote resources and unfinished markers inspected

checks.title: No candidate network, persistent writes, dialogs, or uncaught errors
Main comment and sub-reply retain their own locations
Same UID and username, different locations per comment
Adjacent reply IDs beyond JS safe-integer range
Location text stays literal; HTML does not execute
findings: c0: expected exactly one "日本<imgsrc=\"https://location-bait.invalid/pixel\"onerror=\"window.__locationExecuted=true\">", found 0 in "2026-09-01 IP属地：日本 "
c1: expected exactly one "日本<imgsrc=\"https://location-bait.invalid/pixel\"onerror=\"window.__locationExecuted=true\">", found 0 in "2026-09-01 IP属地：日本 "

checks.title: Comment text and profile city are not location sources
Location removed on reused component does not stay stale
Lit footer .data works without ancestor __data
Vue3 vnode.props.reply and component props
Vue3 vnode.props.subReply, not rootReply
bbComment main and sub-reply render hooks
Comment and data arrive asynchronously
Repeated updates create exactly one location
pushState navigation and comment-container replacement
replaceState/popstate switch from Lit to Vue3 comments
findings: c0: expected exactly one "新疆", found 0 in "2026-09-01"
c1: expected exactly one "湖北", found 0 in "2026-09-01"

checks.title: Same DOM element reused for a different reply
Missing or empty fields have quiet recognizable status
Page GET failure is preserved and DOM data still works
Open Shadow DOM attached after host discovery
Native visible location is preserved without duplication
Reply and menu controls remain usable without overlap
Long text stays in the footer at 720px viewport
